reviews.text: Estoy un poco decepcionada la verdad, justo hoy me acaba de llegar el paquete con los productos para el cabello y el cuerpo de HeveBlue que pedí y desde empeze a abrirlo, note un olor rico, pero eso significaba que algo se había roto o abierto y estaba en lo correcto, porque el gel de ducha estaba esparcido en el interior de la caja. 😔
reviews.zh: 我有啲失望，真係。今日啱啱收到我訂嘅 HeveBlue 頭髮同身體產品包裹，我一開始拆開，就聞到好香，但係呢個意味住有嘢爆咗或者開咗，而事實就係咁，沐浴露散落晒喺個盒入面。😔

reviews.text: Absolutely love this body wash! The scent is pretty heavy and very fruity, but I think it smells delicious. It leaves your skin silky, soft, and moisturized; you barely even need to use a body lotion afterwards. Highly recommend.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢款沐浴露！香味好濃，果香味好重，但係我覺得好好聞。用完皮膚滑、軟、水潤，你幾乎唔使再塗身體乳。大力推薦。

reviews.text: Respecte le film hydrolipidique de la peau qui reste douce après la douche. Son parfum est très agréable. J’ai une peau réactive et depuis quelques années, je ne pouvais plus utiliser les produits parfumés, même de marque en parfumerie, sans avoir la peau asséchée avec l’apparition de plaques. Je revis avec cette marque, j’allie l’utile à l’agréable. Je conseille fortement avec son lait hydratant.
reviews.zh: 保護皮膚嘅水脂膜，沖完涼之後皮膚仍然柔軟。佢嘅香味好好。我皮膚係反應性皮膚，幾年嚟我已經唔可以用含香料嘅產品，連香水專櫃嘅品牌都唔行，否則皮膚會乾燥、起斑塊。我因為呢個品牌，重新可以好好護理皮膚，一舉兩得。我強烈推薦佢嘅保濕乳液。

reviews.text: not sure if it does anything but it definitely smells super good, a little too good for my likings tho cuz my skin is more on the sensitive side
reviews.zh: 唔肯定有冇效果，但係味道絕對好好聞，對我嚟講有少少太香咗，因為我嘅皮膚比較偏敏感。

reviews.text:
Very fruity scent. Lather very well. Wash off very quick and skin feels soft, smooth and hydrated. Wish it comes in a BIGGER bottle.
Definitely will repurchase again.
reviews.zh:
果香好濃。起泡好好。沖走好快，皮膚感覺軟滑、光滑、水潤。希望有更大嘅樽裝。
一定會再買。

reviews.text: I’m really happy with this product! The texture feels light on the skin and absorbs quickly without leaving any stickiness. It gives my skin a nice healthy glow and keeps it hydrated throughout the day. After using it consistently, I’ve noticed my skin looks smoother and more balanced. It’s gentle, effective, and a great addition to my routine. ( • q • ｡)
reviews.zh: 我對呢款產品好滿意！質地輕盈，吸收得好快，唔會黏手。佢令皮膚有好健康嘅光澤，全日都保持水潤。持續用咗之後，我覺得皮膚更加順滑、更平衡。佢温和、有效，係我日常護理嘅好好補充。 ( • q • ｡)

reviews.text: I got the set of the body wash & the body cream! Best decision ever. No harmful ingredients & a gentle foam that feels nourishing. Paired with the products of the same line, my skin just drinks it up!
reviews.zh: 我買咗沐浴露同身體乳嘅套裝！最正嘅決定！冇有害成分，泡沫温和，帶滋養感。同同系列嘅產品一齊用，我嘅皮膚即刻就吸收晒！

reviews.text: this body wash is amazing , the scent the texture and how great it works for my dry skin is amazing. I just wish it was more bigger and reasonable
reviews.zh: 呢款沐浴露好好！味道、質地，同埋對我乾性皮膚嘅效果都好正。我只希望容量再大啲，價錢再合理啲。

note: 以下評價由 YesStyle 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
